newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: TranzRail to buy 61 former UK carriages.
newsitem.headline: TranzRail to buy 61 former UK carriages.

text.p: Tranz Rail Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it would buy 61 rail carriages, all once part of the British Rail Fleet, to upgrade its passenger fleet.
Some will begin entering service in the Wellington Tranz Metro area within the next 18 months and the remainder will join the long distance Tranz Scenic services.
The carriages, being bought from a number of sources, will be refurbished and undergo a number of modifications before entering New Zealand service.
Tranz Rail said the purchase would allow it to replace almost all of its long distance passenger fleet over the next five years.
